messages:
maria-peopleops: Heads up team we pushed an amendment to the handbook this morning: expanded parental & adoption leave policy + clarified short-term bereavement language. Please skim the summary and ACK by Mon 2025-11-10. Full diff: https://internal.redwood/repo/handbook/commits/1752104820

leah.peopleops: TL;DR in the repo: new eligibility rules for adoption, updated pay parity for 12 weeks, and an intake form for leaves at https://forms.redwood/leave-request. Managers should not circulate the PDF copy outside of HR channel.

nina-legal: Quick note Are any sections retroactive? We need clear effective dates. I'll add a redline to `handbook/leave.md` if needed.

maria-peopleops: No retroactivity. Effective date 2025-11-15. @nina-legal please confirm the confidentiality blurb in sec 4.2.

sam.eng: Acked. One ask: for team leads taking leave overlap, do we have recommended on-call handoff wording?

leah.peopleops: Yes recommended handoff snippet in the manager playbook: `handbook/manager-playbook/oncall-handoff.md` — 3 bullets: owner, runway, escalation contact.

dev-manager: I'll copy that into our onboarding checklist. Also tagging @alex-recruiting we need the offer template updated to include the new leave eligibility verbiage for mid-year hires.

alex-recruiting: On it. I'll submit a change to `templates/offer-letter.md` and link the PR here when ready. Expected by EOD Thu.

onboarding-bot: New assignment: "Data Privacy & Handling 2025" has been attached to all new hires and current staff who haven't completed it. Course length ~25m. Link: https://training.redwood/courses/data-privacy-2025.

compliance-bot: Reminder: course due 2025-11-17. Teams with >90% completion will get a completion report emailed to managers. Weekly digest will be sent every Fri.

maria-peopleops: Contractors are exempt from the paid leave update but must follow the data privacy training. Please add contractor names to the contractor log: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/contractor-log and mark whether they require access to PII.

nina-legal: Note for international teams: EU and UK employees follow local statutory minimums. The handbook language is a company baseline, not a replacement for local policies.

sam.eng: Managers: please confirm on this thread once you've added the training to your onboarding checklist and notified direct reports. I'll aggregate confirmations for Eng.

leah.peopleops: I'll host two 20-min office hours: Thu 11:30am PT and Fri 4:00pm PT to walk through the changes and answer questions. If you want the slides, ping me and I'll drop them in the #people-ops-resources channel.

dev-manager: Acked and I'll attend Thu.

alex-recruiting: PR opened: `templates/offer-letter.md` #57. Updated benefits clause links to the new handbook section.

maria-peopleops: Thanks all. I'll run the ack report next Monday and follow up with any outstanding teams. For any legal or payroll edge cases, tag @nina-legal or @leah.peopleops.
